summary: Idaho-Montana border summit: stone shelter from 1920, cupola cabin in 1928, gone by 1955; the summit now holds an electronics site.

facts.design: Cupola cabin (1928), which replaced a 1920 stone shelter
facts.status_note: Cupola cabin gone by 1955; the summit now holds an electronics site with very few remnants of the past.

corrections.why: The Idaho pages and the Shoshone County list name the Coeur d'Alene National Forest, and firelookout.com names both forests. The record lists only Kootenai. The editor should confirm.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho sources and the Shoshone County list say Coeur d'Alene National Forest. The Montana list says Kootenai National Forest. firelookout.com says both. The story reports the disagreement.

notes_for_editor: Elevation is 6,480 feet, about 1,975 m; elevation_m is null in the record, and there is no elevation key in facts. No source gives a height, so height_m is not set. No source documents staffing, so the only staffing fact is unstaffed as of 1955. The 1931 newspaper item is about a road along the divide, not the lookout; it is included as context for access. The sources do not say who owns or runs the electronics site, or whether the public may enter it. Notable fires: none in these sources.
